headline: CNA Financial (NYSE:CNA) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations
summary: Insurance provider CNA Financial (NYSE:CNA) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 1.8% year on year to $3.83 billion. Its GAAP profit of $1.18 per share was 12.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
